description: Switch a prepress view or panel on screen so a human can check the file before it goes to print: overprint preview, print tiling, the separations preview panel, the flattener preview panel, or the attributes panel. Illustrator does not report whether a view or panel is currently showing, so these switch rather than set: call the tool again to switch back. Note: Illustrator will be activated (brought to the foreground) during execution, because this runs a menu command and menu commands fail when it is in the background.

view.description: Which view or panel to switch
